name: Mazapan
startIntroPart1: We didn't have much, even before the end. Our small franchise in our small town didn't get us much. Nowadays, even our clients have dried up. Yet our bakery has survived.
startIntroPart2: So long as treats and confections can still be made, we will uphold the creed of our company: To bake ourselves into the spotlight. So fire up the ovens, y'all. Our mighty Mazapan must flow.
attacked: Are you sure? You aren't going to get any for free!
introduction: Welcome, welcome! Come to see our stock?
tradeRequest: Would you like a special shipment?
